answer: For business procurement agents, count verified controlling owners rather than account names. A registrar checks company filings and owner IDs, then issues one bidding credential per owner group. A marble supplier cannot gain three free bid slots by registering timber and vine subsidiaries: the registry links their control and shares one quota. Evading the limit requires genuinely independent owners or document fraud, which audits can penalize. This relies on current ownership records, risks privacy, and cannot stop collusion among real owners.
